label: #356 asked to derive no component is first being
summary: #356 asked to derive STMT-NO-COMPONENT-IS-FIRST-BEING. The route premises alone do not suffice: component priority runs from component to composite, and the uniting cause is prior only to the composite, so a first being that is a component contradicts nothing there. ST I q.3 a.8's own third reason supplies the structure: each component is in potency or participated; potency is posterior to act (route premise, with the route's same-respect exclusion), and the participated has another cause (the definition-linked q.44 a.1 statement, encoded as a supported sibling), which as efficient cause is prior (existing Secunda Via reading). Five omission controls and a positive model.
blocker: The exhaustiveness of 'potential or participated' over all components is an analyst reading of q.3 a.8 (supported, not stated). The uniting-cause route suggested in #356 does not yield the conclusion without a further premise that the uniting cause is prior to each component.
